title: Investigating the efficacy of vortex beam speckle patterns for the recognition of atmospheric turbulence and fractional topological charge with a deep learning model
abstract: arXiv:2611.34573v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Fractional topological charge (TC) enlarges the usable mode set of orbital angular momentum (OAM) links, but reading it reliably after atmospheric turbulence remains difficult. Interferometric and diffractive methods need an undistorted beam and a careful alignment, while most learned approaches treat integer or coarsely spaced charges and do not include turbulence. Here we ask whether the charge of a scalar vortex beam can be regressed directly from a single speckle image, and at which turbulence strength this stops working. We propagate vortex beams over 1500~m through 150 von K\'arm\'an phase screens, scatter them with a fixed random diffuser, and record $256\times256$, 16-bit speckle images for TC from 0 to 10 in steps of 0.01 and turbulence strengths $D/r_0$ from 0 to 50; the results reported here use a subset of 20\,000 images, and a data set of $10^{6}$ images is in preparation. translated_title: 利用深度学习模型研究涡旋光束散斑图案识别大气湍流与分数拓扑荷的有效性
translated_abstract: 分数拓扑荷（TC）扩大了轨道角动量（OAM）链路的可用模式集合，但在经过大气湍流后可靠地读取它仍然十分困难。干涉法和衍射法需要无畸变的光束和精细的校准，而大多数机器学习方法仅处理整数或粗间隔的拓扑荷，且未考虑湍流的影响。本研究探讨标量涡旋光束的拓扑荷能否直接从单张散斑图像中回归得到，以及在多大的湍流强度下该方法会失效。我们让涡旋光束通过150个冯·卡门（von Kármán）相位屏传播1500米，用固定的随机散射片对其进行散射，并记录拓扑荷从0到10（步长0.01）、湍流强度D/r0从0到50的256×256、16位散斑图像；本文报告的结果使用了20,000张图像的子集，一个包含10^6张图像的数据集正在准备中。一个卷积神经网络用于估计拓扑荷……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出利用卷积神经网络直接从单张散斑图像中回归涡旋光束的分数拓扑荷并识别大气湍流强度，验证了该方法在宽范围湍流条件下（D/r0为0到50）识别分数拓扑荷（精度达0.01）的有效性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes using a convolutional neural network to directly regress the fractional topological charge of vortex beams from single speckle images while recognizing atmospheric turbulence, demonstrating its efficacy across a wide range of turbulence strengths with 0.01 charge resolution.
